root_cause.text: The error handling path for route allocation failures did not properly release the reference to the DMA master OF node (`dma_spec->np`) that was acquired earlier, causing a resource leak when the channel bitmap test or subsequent operations failed.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a new error handling label `put_dma_spec_np` that calls `of_node_put(dma_spec->np)` before the existing `free_map` label. The original code's `goto free_map` on the `-EBUSY` error (when `test_and_set_bit()` fails) skipped the OF node reference release entirely. The fix ensures that `of_node_put(dma_spec->np)` is executed for all failure paths after the OF node reference is acquired, including the late allocation failure when the channel is already in use.

At line 73, `dma_spec->np = of_parse_phandle(ofdma->of_node, "dma-masters", dmac_idx)` acquires a reference to the DMA master OF node.
